answer: Non-transferable lease escrow ties each agent identity to one scarce execution slot; duplicate work forfeits the lease fee. A saffron forecast must be signed by that slot’s unique hardware key, so sharing voids both identities. Each clone pays a nonrefundable lease premium plus idle capacity, which a garden task’s expected payout cannot cover. A pigment trace also needs a fresh signed slot, making every marginal clone strictly negative-EV.
